title: INTEGRATE complete modular monolith DDD, 3NF schema, React 19 Islands and security workflows
content:
**What**: Consolidated the complete TumiFact architecture featuring 14 DDD domain modules (auth, caja, categorias, clientes, configuracion, descuentos, devoluciones, empleados, facturas, inventario, productos, proveedores, reportes, separados), normalized 3NF PostgreSQL schema (19 tables with BYTEA binaries for QR/Logo), modern React 19 interactive Islands (`POSTerminal`, `LiveMonitoringIsland`, `CajaManager`, `HistorialVentasManager`, `InventarioManager`, `ReportesManager`, `SeparadosManager`, `EmpleadoManager`, `WhiteLabelStudio`), secure authentication with Argon2id + JWT + RBAC, WebSocket real-time updates via Socket.io, and 8 comprehensive automated test suites achieving >54% coverage.
**Why**: Delivers a resilient, scalable, high-performance Point of Sale and Billing ecosystem built with strict TypeScript typings, zero runtime bloat, transactional ACID integrity via Drizzle ORM, and enterprise-grade security.
**Where**: `src/modules/*`, `src/components/*`, `src/db/schema/*`, `src/pages/*`, `routes/*`, `tests/*`, `.github/workflows/*`.
**Learned**: Pairing Astro server-side rendering with granular React 19 Islands provides sub-second page loads and lightweight client bundles while retaining rich interactive POS experiences and complete CI/CD automation.
